description.en: Ctrl+F find bar over a DSH conversation transcript: every hit is highlighted in place with the CSS Custom Highlight API, stepping jumps to the nearest match and holds the scroll position against the tail follower, hits are cleared when the session changes, and the transcript stays natively selectable for Ctrl+C.
description.zh: DSH 会话内的 Ctrl+F 查找条：命中用 CSS Custom Highlight API 原位高亮，逐个跳转时按距离最近优先并顶住自动跟底，切换会话即清空，正文保持可原生选中复制。
